warning: Presence in this catalogue is not legal clearance, theological approval, proof of a working download route, or proof that the resource has been downloaded/imported. Check current licences and individual components before acquisition.

resources.title: Awesome Biblical Data
resources.purpose: Curated index for discovering downloadable biblical datasets; index only, not a substitute for acquiring each source.
resources.download_route: Clone the repository and inspect resource entries; follow each source's own release/download instructions.
resources.licence_claim: Repository licence and each linked dataset licence must be checked independently.
resources.notes: Use as a discovery catalogue, not as an approved biblical corpus.

resources.title: STEP Bible Data Repository
resources.purpose: Hebrew and Greek text resources, morphology, semantic tags, textual and lexical datasets; key structured data source.
resources.download_route: git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/STEPBible/STEPBible-Data.git; pin commit and retain notices.
resources.formats: TSV, Sword modules and source files
resources.licence_claim: Repository states CC BY 4.0; inspect included/source-specific notices and attribution requirements.
resources.notes: Tyndale House-originated and STEPBible-curated data.

resources.title: Open Scriptures Hebrew Bible (OSHB)
resources.purpose: Hebrew Bible in OSIS XML with lemmas and morphological tagging; WLC base text and OSHB annotations must be distinguished.
resources.download_route: Clone official repository; acquire pinned source files from the wlc directory and preserve LICENSE.md.
resources.licence_claim: WLC text public domain; OSHB lemma/morphology data CC BY 4.0.
resources.notes: Morphological coverage and transcription status vary; validate coverage and field completeness.

resources.title: Westminster Leningrad Codex (WLC)
resources.purpose: Masoretic Hebrew base-text witness for Old Testament study.
resources.download_route: Use Tanach.us download facilities or obtain WLC files through the official OSHB/MACULA source chain; pin version.
resources.licence_claim: WLC base text is identified as public domain by source projects; verify selected file and edition notice.
resources.notes: Do not confuse WLC base text with copyrighted printed critical editions or apparatus.

resources.title: MACULA Greek Linguistic Datasets
resources.purpose: Greek NT syntax trees, morphology, word senses, semantic frames, participant referents and related mappings.
resources.download_route: Clone repository and pin commit; preserve LICENSE.md and source-component notices.
resources.formats: Node XML, Lowfat XML, TSV and supporting tables
resources.licence_claim: Clear Bible MACULA data states CC BY 4.0; included third-party datasets can have separate licences.
resources.notes: Do not assume every component inherits the top-level licence; preserve component attribution.

resources.title: MACULA Hebrew Linguistic Datasets
resources.purpose: Hebrew Bible syntax trees, morphology, word senses, semantic roles and participant referents.
resources.download_route: Clone repository and pin commit; retain all licence files and component source declarations.
resources.licence_claim: Mixed component rights; Clear/Groves and contributing datasets have separately identified terms.
resources.notes: Review the exact source-component list and licence before importing each folder.

resources.title: ETCBC BHSA
resources.purpose: Highly structured Hebrew text, phrase/clause hierarchy, morphology, syntax and linguistic annotation.
resources.download_route: Clone pinned repository and inspect the licence and Text-Fabric release instructions.
resources.licence_claim: Repository identifies CC BY-NC 4.0.
resources.notes: Keep quarantined pending owner/legal confirmation that intended distribution qualifies.

resources.title: SHEBANQ
resources.purpose: Query interface for the ETCBC Hebrew database; the website itself is not the offline dataset.
resources.download_route: Do not treat the site as offline content. Acquire and validate the underlying BHSA dataset separately.
resources.licence_claim: Underlying BHSA licence applies; the website is not itself an offline corpus package.
resources.notes: Not eligible as an offline resource by itself.

resources.title: SBL Greek New Testament
resources.purpose: Critically edited Greek New Testament base text.

resources.notes: Do not attribute the SBLGNT text licence to the morphology or vice versa.
